senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) lamb, young goat or young sheep.
units: Bekh. I, 5 ר׳ א׳ מתיר בכלאים מפני שהוא שה R. El. permits the redemption of a first-born ass with a hybrid of goat and sheep, because it goes by the name of seh (complying with the law Ex. XIII, 13).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56:4">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 22:8">Gen. XXII, 8</cite>) <he>אלהים יראה לו השה בני ואם לאו אתה השה לעולה בני</he> God will provide himself a lamb, my son, and if not, thou art the lamb for the offering, my son; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>יזמן קרבנו ואם לא שה לעולה בני</he> he will prepare his sacrifice, and if not, my son be the lamb for the offering.
Ib. שה לעולה סי לעילה לשון יונית (not חי) ‘seh for an offering’ is the Greek σέ (thee) for an offering.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 12a:14">Bekh. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>אביו שה</he> its sire is a sheep.
Ib. 7ᵃ שה מכל מקום a seh (young of sheep or of goats) under all conditions (even if it has the looks of an unclean animal).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 27a:9">B. Mets. 27ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.
